## 2.1 Load Libraries

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
if (!nzchar(system.file(package = "librarian"))) 
  install.packages("librarian")

librarian::shelf(
  quiet = TRUE,
  librarian, conflicted, ggplot2, tibble, tidyr, readr, purrr, dplyr, stringr,
  forcats, lubridate, glue, fs, magrittr, here,
  
 # additional
  obistools, worrms, writexl
)

conflicts_prefer(
  dplyr::filter(), 
  dplyr::select()
  )
  
base_dir <- here("data", "reach_ecotaxa")
```

This function will help select the lowest taxonomic name, that depends on the 
level set in `const`

```{r taxa-func}
taxa_func <- function(..., incld_lvl = TRUE) {
  dat <- c(...) # combine all names into a vector
  taxa_name <- NA
  # loop through all names to select the lowest name
  for (i in seq(length(dat))) {
    if (is.na(taxa_name)) {
      taxa_name <- dat[i]
    }
  }
  if (incld_lvl) {
    taxa_name <- glue("{taxa_name} ({names(taxa_name)})")
  }
  return(taxa_name)
}

# order of taxonomic classification
taxa_tree <- 
  c("kingdom", "phylum", "class", "order", "family", "genus", "valid_name") %>%
  rev()

taxa_lvl <- "class" # lowest taxa level

taxa_lvl <- taxa_tree[which(taxa_tree == taxa_lvl):length(taxa_tree)]
```

## 2.3 Load Validated Images

```{r val-img}
zoo_validated_path <- here(base_dir, "reach_zoo_validated.csv")

if (!file_exists(zoo_validated_path)) {
  # path to validated zoo file
  zoo_val_path <-
    base_dir %>%
    dir_ls() %>%
    str_subset("ecotaxa_export") %>%
    str_subset("score", negate = TRUE) %>%
    print()

  # column names
  col_names <-
    read_tsv(zoo_val_path, n_max = 0, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
    names()

  # read and filter
  zoo_validated <-
    read_tsv_chunked(
      zoo_val_path,
      chunk_size     = 100000,
      show_col_types = FALSE,
      callback       = DataFrameCallback$new(function(x, pos) {
        message(glue("Row number: {pos} (in 100,000 row chunks)"))
        x <- x %>%
          filter(str_detect(object_annotation_status, "validated")) %>%
          # filter_out(str_detect(object_annotation_category, "detrit|artefact")) %>%
          mutate(object_time_end = as.numeric(object_time_end))
        return(x)
      })
    )

  write_csv(zoo_validated, zoo_validated_path, na = "")
  
  rm(zoo_val_path, col_names)
  
} else {
  message("Loading validated file.")
  zoo_validated <- read_csv(zoo_validated_path, show_col_types = FALSE, guess_max = Inf)
}

zoo_validated
distinct(zoo_validated, object_annotation_category)
```

## 2.4 Load Predicted Images with Score > 0.5

```{r pred-img}
zoo_predict_path <- here(base_dir, "reach_zoo_predict.csv")

if (!file_exists(zoo_predict_path)) {
  # path to predicted zoo file
  zoo_pred_path <-
    base_dir %>%
    dir_ls() %>%
    str_subset("ecotaxa_export") %>%
    str_subset("score", negate = FALSE) %>%
    print()

  # column names
  col_names <-
    read_tsv(zoo_pred_path, n_max = 0, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
    names()
  
  # read and filter
  zoo_predicted <-
    read_tsv_chunked(
      zoo_pred_path,
      chunk_size     = 100000,
      show_col_types = FALSE,
      callback       = DataFrameCallback$new(function(x, pos) {
        message(pos)
        x <- x %>%
          filter_out(str_detect(object_annotation_category, "detrit|artefact")) %>%
          mutate(object_time_end = as.numeric(object_time_end))
        return(x)
      })
    )
  
   write_csv(zoo_predicted, zoo_predict_path, na = "")
  
  rm(zoo_pred_path, col_names)
  
} else {
  message("Loading predict file.")
   zoo_predicted <- read_csv(zoo_predict_path, show_col_types = FALSE, guess_max = Inf)
}

zoo_predicted
```

Filter bad out acquisitions (10/16/2026)
* REACH_REACH_002-S07- 1, 2
* REACH_003_S07 -
* REACH_003_S23 - 1, 2, 4
* REACH_003_S17C26 - 1
* REACH_004_S21 - 6, 5, 4
* REACH_004_S17C26 - 8, 7, 6, 3, 4
* REACH_005_S23 - 4
* REACH_005_S14 - 3
* REACH_005_S03 - 1, 2
* REACH_005_S05 - 1
* REACH_007_S03BB - 4, 3

```{r merge}
zoo_merged <-

        paste("REACH_005_S23", c(4), sep = "_", collapse = "|"),
        paste("REACH_005_S14", c(3), sep = "_", collapse = "|"),

        paste("REACH_005_S05", c(1), sep = "_", collapse = "|"),
```

## 2.6 Taxa List

```{r merge}
taxa_list_path <- here(base_dir, "reach_master_taxa_extend.xlsx")

taxa_data <- 
  zoo_merged %>%
  distinct(object_annotation_category)

# ---- if a previous taxa list doesnt exist, create one ---- #
if (!file_exists(taxa_list_path)) {
  old <- FALSE
  message("Creating master taxa list!")
  # extract taxa list from object_annotation_category
  taxa_list <-
    taxa_data %>%
    mutate(
      search_name = object_annotation_category,
      worrms = obistools::match_taxa(search_name)
    ) %>%
    unnest(worrms)

  taxa_list

  taxa_list %>%
    filter(is.na(scientificName))

  taxa_list_extended <-
    taxa_list %>%
    select(-match_type) %>%
    mutate(
      acceptedNameUsageID = as.numeric(acceptedNameUsageID),
      taxa = map(
        acceptedNameUsageID,
        \(.x) {
          if (is.na(.x)) {
            return(NULL)
          }
          worrms::wm_record(.x)
        }
      )
    ) %>%
    unnest(taxa, keep_empty = TRUE) %>%
    select(
      object_annotation_category, search_name, scientificName, AphiaID, 
      scientificname, valid_name, rank, kingdom:genus
    ) %>% 
    arrange(kingdom, phylum, class, order, family, genus) %>%
    mutate(include = NA, multiplicative = NA)
  
  writexl::write_xlsx(
    taxa_list_extended,
    taxa_list_path
  )
  
} else {
  old <- TRUE
  message("Reading previously created master taxa list.")
  taxa_list_extended <- readxl::read_xlsx(taxa_list_path)
}


# ---- check if new species exist ---- #
new_taxa <-
  full_join(
    taxa_list_extended,
    taxa_data
  ) %>%
   mutate(
      search_name = if_else(is.na(search_name), object_annotation_category, search_name)
   ) %>%
  filter(is.na(valid_name) & !str_detect(search_name, "ignore")) %>%
  distinct(object_annotation_category, search_name)

new_taxa

if (nrow(new_taxa) > 0 & old) {
  taxa_list2 <-
    new_taxa %>%
    mutate(
      worrms = obistools::match_taxa(search_name)
    ) %>%
    unnest(worrms)

  taxa_list2_extended <- 
    taxa_list2 %>%
    select(-match_type) %>%
    mutate(
      acceptedNameUsageID = as.numeric(acceptedNameUsageID),
      taxa = map(
        acceptedNameUsageID,
        \(.x) {
          if (is.na(.x)) {
            return(NULL)
          }
          worrms::wm_record(.x)
        }
      )
    ) %>%
    unnest(taxa, keep_empty = TRUE) %>%
    select(
      object_annotation_category, search_name, scientificName, AphiaID, 
      scientificname, valid_name, rank, kingdom:genus
    )
  
  if (!any(taxa_list_extended$object_annotation_category %in% taxa_list2_extended$object_annotation_category)) {
    taxa_list_extended <-
      taxa_list2_extended %>%
      filter_out(object_annotation_category %in% taxa_list_extended$object_annotation_category) %>%
      bind_rows(
        taxa_list_extended,
        .,
      ) %>%
      arrange(kingdom, phylum, class, order, family, genus)
  }
  
  taxa_list_extended <-
    rows_patch(
      taxa_list_extended,
      taxa_list2_extended,
      by = c("object_annotation_category", "search_name"),
      unmatched = "ignore"
    ) %>%
    arrange(kingdom, phylum, class, order, family, genus)
  
  taxa_list_extended
  
  if (FALSE) {
    writexl::write_xlsx(
      taxa_list_extended,
      taxa_list_path
      )
  }
  
}

taxa_not_included <- 
  taxa_list_extended %>%
  filter_out(is.na(include) | str_detect(include, "(?i)y"))

taxa_level <- 
  taxa_list_extended %>%
  mutate(
    # select the lowest taxa name available
    taxa_level = pmap(
      across(all_of(c(taxa_lvl))),
      incld_lvl = FALSE,
      taxa_func
    ),
  ) %>%
  unnest(taxa_level)

select(taxa_level, 1, 2, valid_name, taxa_level)
```

# 3.0 Count Images and Volume per Sample and Acquisition

```{r}
# count images per acquisition
zoo_sum <-
  zoo_merged %>%
  left_join(
    taxa_list_extended,
    by = "object_annotation_category"
  ) %>%
  filter_out(str_detect(search_name, "ignore")) %>%
  
  # adds rows to the number of extra cells 
  mutate(
    multiplicative = if_else(is.na(multiplicative), 1, multiplicative)
  ) %>%
  uncount(weights = multiplicative) %>%
  
  # select functional name to aggregate taxa names
  mutate(func_name = object_annotation_category) %>%
  summarise(
    .by = c(sample_id, acq_id, object_lat, object_lon, object_date, object_time, 
            func_name, sample_gear_net_opening, 
            sample_concentrated_sample_volume, sample_dilution_factor, 
            acq_imaged_volume
            ),
    count = n()
  ) %>%
  group_by(
    sample_id, object_lat, object_lon, object_date,
    object_time, sample_gear_net_opening, sample_concentrated_sample_volume, 
    sample_dilution_factor,
    ) %>%
   complete(
    acq_id,
    func_name,
    fill = list(count = 0),
    explicit = FALSE
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  fill(
    acq_imaged_volume,
    .by = acq_id,
    .direction = "downup"
  )

zoo_sum

# sum volume for total sample
acq_total_vol <- 
  zoo_sum %>%
  distinct(sample_id, acq_id, acq_imaged_volume) %>%
  reframe(
    .by = sample_id, 
    acq_imaged_volume_total = sum(acq_imaged_volume),
    total_acq = n()
    )

acq_total_vol
```



```{r}
pivot_wider(
  data         = zoo_sum,
  # id_cols      = c(), # *optional* vector of unaffected columns,
  names_from   = c(func_name), # category column(s) to pivot wide
  values_from  = c(count), # value column(s) that hold data for each category column
  names_sep    = "_",
  names_repair = janitor::make_clean_names
  )
```

```{r}
zoo_wide_aq <- 
  left_join(
    zoo_sum,
    acq_total_vol
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    .before = object_lat,
    .by = c(sample_id, func_name),
    count2 = row_number()
  ) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    data         = .,
    id_cols      = c(sample_id, object_lat:sample_dilution_factor, func_name,
                     acq_imaged_volume_total, total_acq), # *optional* vector of unaffected columns,
    names_from   = c(count2), # category column(s) to pivot wide
    values_from  = count, # value column(s) that hold data for each category column
    names_repair = janitor::make_clean_names,
    names_prefix = "acq_"
  ) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    total_count = sum(c_across(acq_1:last_col()), na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    ind_per_sample = 
      (total_count / acq_imaged_volume_total) * 
      sample_concentrated_sample_volume 
  )

zoo_wide_aq

# check where no sample concentrated sample volume exists
no_conc_vol <- 
  filter(zoo_wide_aq, is.na(sample_concentrated_sample_volume)) %>%
  distinct(sample_id) %T>%
  print() %>%
  pull(sample_id) %>%
  paste(collapse = "|")

filter(zoo_wide_aq, str_detect(sample_id, no_conc_vol)) %>%
  distinct(sample_id)

# check where acquisitions do not equal 3
filter(zoo_wide_aq, total_acq != 3) %>%
  distinct(sample_id, total_acq, acq_imaged_volume_total, object_date) %>%
  arrange(object_date) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  pull(sample_id) %>%
  cat(sep = "-\n")
  
```




```{r}
zoo_wide_aq %>%
  pivot_wider(
    data         = .,
    id_cols      = c(sample_id:acq_imaged_volume_total), # *optional* vector of unaffected columns,
    names_from   = c(func_name), # category column(s) to pivot wide
    values_from  = c(ind_per_sample), # value column(s) that hold data for each category column
    names_sep    = "_",
```

## Extract Metadata and Align with Zooplankton Data

```{r}
meta_merge <-
  zoo_wide_aq  %>%
  distinct(sample_id) %>%
  mutate(
    
    # fix different sample ID names
    sample_id2 = recode_values(
      sample_id,
      "REACH_REAC002S08"       ~ "REACH_002_S08",
      "REACH_REACH_002-S07"    ~ "REACH_002_S07",
      "REACH_REACH_002-S07"    ~ "REACH_002-S07",			
      "REACH_REACH_002_S14"    ~ "REACH_002_S14",
      "REACH_REACH_002_S17C26" ~ "REACH_002_S17C26",
      "REACH_003_S10" ~ "REACH_003_S10C25",
      default = sample_id
    )
  ) %>%
  separate_wider_delim(
    cols        = sample_id2,
    names       = c("cruise_id", "cruise_num", "station"),
    delim       = "_",
    too_many    = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    cruise_id = glue("{cruise_id}{cruise_num}"),
    station   = str_to_upper(station),
    station   = str_remove(station, "BB|BA"),
    bongo = recode_values(
      sample_id,
      "REACH_004_S17C26"       ~ "BA",
      "REACH_004_S21"          ~ "BA",
      "REACH_REAC002S08"       ~ "BA",
      "REACH_REACH_002-S07"    ~ "BA",
      "REACH_REACH_002_S14"    ~ "BA",
      "REACH_REACH_002_S17C26" ~ "BA",
      "REACH_002_S10C25"       ~ "BA",
      default = "BB"
    )
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    mutate(meta_data, location_id2 = str_remove(location_id, "/")),
    by = c(
      "cruise_id" = "cruise_id",
      "station"   = "location_id2",
      "bongo" = "net_type")
  )

meta_merge

meta_merge %>%
  filter(is.na(mesh_size_um))
```

## Calculate Density (Individuals per m^3)

```{r density-calc}
zoo_abund <-
  right_join(
    meta_merge,
    zoo_wide_aq,
    by = "sample_id"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    vol_filt_flow2 = if_else(is.na(flag),  vol_filt_flow, NA),
    ind_per_sample = ind_per_sample * (1 / ethanol_split),
    ind_m3 = ind_per_sample / vol_filt_flow2,
    ind_m3_2 = round(ind_m3, 2)
  )

zoo_abund

 right_join(
    meta_merge,
    zoo_wide_aq,
    by = "sample_id"
  ) %>%
  distinct(pick(1, 2), station, bongo, pick(contains("_split"))) %>%
  filter(is.na(ethanol_split))

zoo_abund %>%
  select(
    1:6, func_name, ind_m3_2
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(ind_m3_2))

```




```{r}
zoo_abund_merge <- 
  zoo_abund %>%
  filter_out(
    str_detect(func_name, paste(taxa_not_included$valid_name, collapse = "|")) |
    is.na(func_name)
  ) %>%
  # filter(
  #   str_detect(func_name, "Tretomphalus")
  #   
  # ) %>%
  
  left_join(
    select(taxa_level, object_annotation_category, valid_name, taxa_level, include),
    by = c("func_name" = "object_annotation_category")
  ) %>%
  filter_out(str_detect(include, "n")) %>%
  
  mutate(
    .after     = event_date,
    year       = year(event_date), 
    date_month = ym(format(event_date, "%Y-%m")),
    site = station,
    # taxa_level = func_name
    ) %>%
  
  # forces the month to be the same month as the start of the cruise
  # - only occurs if a cruise overlaps 2 different months (i.e. April into May)
  mutate(
    .by = cruise_id,
    date_month = min(date_month, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    .by = c(cruise_id, site, year, date_month, taxa_level),
    ind_m3 = sum(ind_m3),
    num_spc_summed = n()
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    .by     = c(site, date_month),
    total   = sum(ind_m3),
    percent = ind_m3 / total,
    # site    = fct(site, c("MR", "LK", "WS"))
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    taxa_level  = fct_reorder(taxa_level, percent, .fun = max),
    date_month2 = fct_reorder(format(date_month, "%b %Y"), date_month)
  )

zoo_abund_merge

distinct(zoo_abund_merge, taxa_level)
```
